label: Sharp, Hook & Button
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: 1200x1200 e-commerce photograph of a model wearing bright royal-blue textured trousers, cropped waist-to-thigh on a white cut-out background. Visible: closed waistband with two belt loops, one dark button sitting on the waistband just left of the fly, the fly seam, front crease and side pocket edge, plus the model's hand and a black shirt hem. The waistband is FASTENED, so no hook-and-bar, no bar plate and no tab outline can be seen.

182x286 px photograph of grey-blue Prince-of-Wales check trousers laid flat with the FLY OPEN, shot on the closure. Visible: waistband with belt loop and one dark button at upper left, a worked buttonhole beside it, the extension tab at the right carrying a vertical buttonhole and a small dark fitting, the fly facing, and the interior curtain finished with red/magenta piping. This is the waistband extension-and-closure area the field names, opened up so the fastening is exposed.

239x201 px photograph of charcoal/black worsted trousers with the FLY OPEN on the closure. Visible: a button on the waistband at upper left with a worked buttonhole beside it, a second button on the inner right facing, a bright metallic pale fitting on the extension tab that reads as the metal hook-or-bar plate, the fly facing, a red-piped curtain waistband, and the squared straight end of the extension tab.

239x239 px photograph of dark charcoal worsted trousers with the FLY OPEN, framed on the waistband closure. Visible: outer waistband button and worked buttonhole at top left, a button on the inner right facing, a bright pale metal fitting low on the extension tab reading as the hook/bar plate, the ribbed fly facing, red/magenta curtain piping, and a straight squared tab end with topstitching.
